primary_title: TNF superfamily member TL1A elicits type 2 innate lymphoid cells at mucosal barriers
decision_basis: The ILC2 cytokine-regulation review cites the primary TL1A/DR3 study as showing IL-6 secretion from mouse mesenteric-lymph-node ILC2s after TL1A stimulation.
limitations_preserved: Measured IL-6 protein secretion after TL1A stimulation is supported in mouse mesenteric-lymph-node ILC2s; preserve tissue and DR3 context, do not generalize to lung or SCI and do not infer terminal-TF mechanism.
